Real-time voice conversations in Discord voice channels with Claude AI

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of real-time voice conversations in Discord with Claude AI.

- Join and leave Discord voice channels via commands or agent tool.
- Voice Activity Detection (VAD) for automatic listening and transcription.
- Supports multiple Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) providers, including OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, and local options.
- Streaming STT for low latency voice recognition (Deepgram).
- Barge-in support: stop speaking when user interrupts.
- Auto-reconnect and connection health monitoring for reliability.
